Name: Aloe's Milkfish
Author: aceynk
Description:
The dialogue of the fish in fish ponds is a reference to the album Fishmonger by underscores.

The Golden Milkfish is a reference to the Golden Bangus, a real fish that was caught. See: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milkfish#Golden_bangus]https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milkfish#Golden_bangus[/url]. This fish is also referenced in Fishmonger, in the song "the fish song".

Milkfish and Golden Milkfish both can be found: [spoiler]in the ocean, from 6:00 to 18:00, in fall and winter, while raining.[/spoiler]


The github for this mod can be found here: [url=https://github.com/aceynk/AloeMilkfish]https://github.com/aceynk/AloeMilkfish[/url] (though it's nothing compiled or anything so you could find all the files in the zip!)
